title: Tools Audit — 5 High-Confidence Wins
brief: Execute only the 5 evidence-backed migrations from TOOLS-AUDIT-2026-05-01.md after applying the conflict-matrix corrections from TOOLS-AUDIT-2026-05-01-CONFLICTS.md. Defers the 15 lower-confidence recommendations until usage telemetry justifies them. Targets ~3 working days, addresses real incidents (commit 6477d7cd5 handoff clobber, Ollama MCP gap, advisory-hook token leak).
blocked_by_decisions: Decision 1: prism_ollama as new dispatcher? (recommended: yes)
Decision 2: per-hook policy for advisory→MCP vs soften (recommended: convert if fires every prompt; soften if fires only on Edit/Write)
